name: J Cole
description: Jermaine Lamarr Cole is an American rapper and record producer. Born in a military base in Germany and raised in Fayetteville, North Carolina

name: Kendrick Lamar
description: Kendrick Lamar Duckworth is an American rapper. Regarded as one of the greatest rappers of all time, he was awarded the 2018 Pulitzer Prize for Music, becoming the first musician outside of the classical and jazz genres to receive the honor.

name: Drake
description: Aubrey Drake Graham, known mononymously as Drake, is a Canadian rapper, singer, and actor. Named one of the greatest rappers of all time by Billboard, he is credited with popularizing R&B sensibilities in hip-hop music.

name: Taylor Swift
description: Taylor Alison Swift is an American singer-songwriter known for her autobiographical songwriting, artistic versatility, and cultural-impact. A prominent figure in popular music, Swift has received extensive media coverage and has a global fanbase known as Swifties.

name: Olivia Rodrigo
description: Olivia Isabel Rodrigo is an American singer-songwriter and actress. She gained prominence starring in the Disney Channel series Bizaardvark and the Disney+ series High School Musical: The Musical: The Series.

name: ABBA
description: ABBA were a Swedish pop group formed in Stockholm in 1972 by Agnetha Fältskog, Björn Ulvaeus, Benny Andersson, and Anni-Frid Lyngstad. They are one of the most popular and successful musical groups of all time

name: Michael Jackson
description: Michael Joseph Jackson was an American singer, songwriter, dancer, and philanthropist. Dubbed the King of Pop, he is regarded as one of the most significant figures of the 20th century

name: Kenny Rogers
description: Kenneth Ray Rogers was an American singer and songwriter. He was inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame in 2013

name: Rihanna
description: Robyn Rihanna Fenty is a Barbadian singer, businesswoman and actress

name: Bad Bunny
description: Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio, best known by his stage name Bad Bunny, is a Puerto Rican rapper, singer, and record producer
